standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a sheaf on a space by glueing data relative to an open covering
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1188-1200) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the collection of modules generated on the members of a fixed covering into a collection parametrised by subsheaves and glueing data.

standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of a module of finite type as one locally a quotient of a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on modules of finite type, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the modules to be represented with those generated on the members of some covering.

core_obligations: Parametrise by a covering: for a fixed open covering the proof considers the modules whose restriction to each member is a quotient of a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf, and describes them by subsheaves of those finite direct sums together with glueing data on the overlaps (proof lines 1184-1199)

Count the parameters: the glueing data and the coverings indexed injectively by subsets of the space each form a set, so the modules obtained by glueing quotients form a set of indices (proof lines 1200-1204)

Represent all classes: every module of finite type is isomorphic to one of these by definition, so choosing one representative from each isomorphism class inside the collection gives the required set of modules (proof lines 1205-1208)
proof_roadmap: 固定开覆盖 U : X = ⋃U_j，考虑在每个 U_j 上都是 O_{U_j}^{⊕r_j} 的商的模；这些由子层 K_j ⊂ O_{U_j}^{⊕r_j} 与重叠上的粘接数据 φ_{jj'} 参数化（跨章的粘接描述）。
粘接数据的全体与「以 X 的子集为指标的覆盖」的全体都是集合，故这样得到的模构成一个集合 I；每个有限型模都同构于 I 中某元素，在每个同构类中取一个代表即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a set of modules of finite type on a ringed space meeting every isomorphism class exactly once (author lemma at source lines 1174-1181, label lemma-set-isomorphism-classes-finite-type-modules). The proof (source lines 1183-1209) parametrises, for each open covering, the modules generated on its members by subsheaves of finite direct sums together with glueing data, observes that both the glueing data and the coverings form sets, and then selects one representative from each isomorphism class of the resulting set of modules (proof lines 1200-1208). The parametrisation by glueing data is the content. H2.
